items.title: How we took malware advisories beyond npm
items.content:
GitHub malware advisories no longer stop at npm. Here's how we wired OpenSSF's malicious-packages data into the Advisory Database, and why we built the pipeline paranoid.

The post How we took malware advisories beyond npm appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
GitHub malware advisories no longer stop at npm. Here's how we wired OpenSSF's malicious-packages data into the Advisory Database, and why we built the pipeline paranoid.
The post How we took malware advisories beyond npm appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Ankit Kumar Honey

summaries.zh: GitHub已将恶意软件预警范围扩展至npm之外。通过将OpenSSF的恶意包数据接入预警数据库，并构建了名为"paranoid"的管道，实现了这一目标。此举增强了恶意软件检测能力，并提升了安全性。
summaries.en: GitHub has expanded malware advisories beyond npm by integrating OpenSSF's malicious-packages data into its Advisory Database. This enhancement was driven by the need for a more comprehensive security framework. The pipeline was designed with a "paranoid" approach to ensure robust detection and prevention of malicious packages across various sources. The update aims to provide broader protection against software supply chain threats.

items.title: Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed
items.content:
How a branch-free loop and byte-space arithmetic let GitHub case-fold every byte of code search at >45 GiB/s on a single core.

The post Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
How a branch-free loop and byte-space arithmetic let GitHub case-fold every byte of code search at >45 GiB/s on a single core.
The post Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Alexander Neubeck

summaries.zh: GitHub通过分支自由的循环和字节空间算法，在单核上实现超过45 GiB/s的源代码大小写折叠搜索速度。该方法无需停止早期计算，有效提升性能。
summaries.en: GitHub implemented a case-folding process for source code searches using a branch-free loop and byte-space arithmetic, achieving over 45 GiB/s performance on a single core. The method avoids early termination, ensuring full processing of code bytes. The technique enhances search efficiency by leveraging memory-speed operations. The approach was detailed in the blog post "Don’t stop early: Case-folding source code at memory speed."

items.title: Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast
items.content:
Dependabot keeps your dependencies current, but its defaults can flood your repository with pull requests. Here's how grouping updates, slowing the cadence, and keeping security fixes fast cut the noise on a Microsoft open source project.

The post Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Dependabot keeps your dependencies current, but its defaults can flood your repository with pull requests. Here's how grouping updates, slowing the cadence, and keeping security fixes fast cut the noise on a Microsoft open source project.
The post Tame Dependabot: Group your updates, slow the cadence, keep security fast appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Bruno Borges

summaries.zh:
标题：控制 Dependabot：分组更新、放缓节奏、保持安全快速

文章介绍了如何通过分组依赖更新、放缓更新频率，同时保持安全补丁的快速响应，来减少 Dependabot 在代码库中产生的过多 pull 请求。这些方法帮助微软开源项目有效管理依赖更新，降低噪音。
summaries.en: Dependabot can overwhelm repositories with frequent pull requests. To manage this, group updates to reduce noise, slow the cadence for non-security updates, and maintain rapid processing for security fixes. These strategies were applied to a Microsoft open-source project. The GitHub Blog highlights these techniques for effective Dependabot management.
